name: TryFrom<pb::Decision> for Decision (plus Question, DecisionInput)

test_list.description: A Decision holding a Choice, a Score and a Noul answer survives sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk unchanged.
Question (all three kinds) and DecisionInput (with and without context) roundtrip.
NaN, infinity, negative and above-one probabilities on the wire convert to Invalid(InvalidProbability).
An empty or control-character question id / label on the wire gives Invalid(InvalidValue).
A QuestionAnswer without answer, or an Answer without kind, gives MissingField.
Default pb::Decision converts to an empty Decision; default pb::Answer and pb::Question return Err.
For arbitrary valid Decisions: sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk is the identity.
For arbitrary valid Questions (Choice, Score, Noul): sdk -> pb -> bytes -> pb -> sdk is the identity.
Arbitrary bytes decoded as pb::Decision / pb::Question and converted give Ok or Err, never a panic.

dependencies: polaris_sdk::system_one::{Decision, Answer, QuestionAnswer, LabelScore, Question, QuestionKind, QuestionId, Label, Probability, DecisionInput}

inputs.name: decision
inputs.description: A decoded protobuf decision from a worker, possibly hostile.

output_type: Result<Decision, ProtoError> (pb -> sdk) or pb::Decision (sdk -> pb, infallible)
output_description: A Decision whose labels, ids and probabilities passed the sdk validators.
